name: comp-171

frames.best_why: Two stars are amber with the second scaled up under the cursor, showing both the preview fill and the pop.

tagline: Hover the stars and they fill amber up to your pointer.
summary: Five large stars under the line Rate your experience, grey at rest, that preview a score on hover and keep it once clicked. The star under the cursor swells slightly as it lights.
appearance: A big white heading sits above five five-pointed stars in a single row on black, all flat grey until chosen. The stars are widely spaced and all the same size; picked ones turn amber.
behaviour: Hovering a star tints every star up to it amber and briefly enlarges just the hovered one; leaving clears the tint back to the saved score. Clicking locks the fill at that count, and the clip settles on two stars.
demo_content: Rate your experience heading with five empty stars
search_phrases: hover stars to set a rating
use_when: Collecting a one to five score where a hover preview helps people land on the right star count.
avoid_when: No number or word shows the current score, so half stars and a neutral no-score state are impossible.
customise: The heading and the five star values are written in the file, as are the icon size, amber and grey colours and the scale step. A different star count means editing the array.
weight_why: Five SVG stars with a colour and scale transition; idle when untouched.

a11y.note: Each star carries hidden text such as 3 stars and the group shows a focus ring; the hover tint and scale have no reduced-motion guard.

issues: At rest the five stars are dark grey on black, so the control barely shows before hover.
The chosen score is never printed, so people must count the amber stars.
polish_why: Clear hover preview with a neat scale pop; the unrated stars are very faint on black.
title: Interactive Star Rating
